note: Engine facts are read at render time from the release being filmed. Values below were re-read on 14 October 2026 from raw-native main fdee283 (release v0.7.0 is the current release); first read 10 October from main 6b33552 and ba9fb0f. The scene takes every number from the facts block by key.

rn-cert.citation: HarperZ9/raw-native v0.6.0, out/media/certificate.json, recorded in the release media facts.json (commit 158afa8).
claims: Screen-space AO against ray-traced AO for the media view: rmse 0.129436031 against a tolerance of 0.119999997; verdict refuted.
rn-cert.n: 37,996 covered pixels; 64 ray-traced and 24 screen-space samples
rn-cert.quote: screen-space AO matches ray-traced ground truth within tolerance
rn-cert.does_not_prove: Anything about other views or other AO methods; the verdict is for this camera.

claims: MSVC, GCC and the WebAssembly build write byte-identical files for the default render.
rn-readme.does_not_prove: That every render is identical across builds; it is checked for the default render and the identity matrix.

claims: Two renders of ao-check at 640 x 360 on SwiftShader: 1,456 frames each, 0 differing, identical chain hash.
rn-determinism.does_not_prove: Identity across different GPUs or browsers.

claims: 20 vector test cases; the largest per-case mean edge difference against the reference is 0.0277.
rn-vector.does_not_prove: Coverage of every path shape; edge pixels differ more than interior ones, by design of the analytic coverage.

claims: Across 11 colour pipelines the GPU differs from the C++ reference by at most 1 code in 255.
ACES 2.0 SDR to sRGB: largest CIEDE2000 difference from OCIO 0.002431 over 36,787 inputs, bound 0.05.
rn-ocio.interval: Max, p99, mean and median reported.
rn-ocio.does_not_prove: Agreement with other ACES implementations or on HDR outputs, which have their own rows.

claims: The tube is simulated as signal, decoder, beams, mask and glass; dot crawl and rainbowing come from the decoder's errors.
Film is simulated as exposure through three layers, development, print and projection; halation from the base.

Halation: light reaching the 0.125 mm film base comes back by total internal reflection; without the remjet a ring appears at 2 t tan(theta_c) = 0.22 mm (CONSTANTS.md: geometry high confidence, base thickness low).
rn-shaders.quote: Most phosphor, mask, glass and film-stock constants are low confidence
rn-shaders.does_not_prove: That the looks are better than any other shader; the comparison protocol has not run.

rn-crt-parity.citation: HarperZ9/raw-native evidence/shaders-crt-parity-swiftshader.json, bounds fixed before the first run.
claims: 9 tube cases at 640 x 480: maximum difference 1 code in 255 in every case.
rn-crt-parity.does_not_prove: Parity on hardware GPUs or at 4K.

claims: 6 film cases at 480 x 270: maximum difference 1 code in 255 in every case.
rn-film-parity.does_not_prove: That the film looks like any particular stock; the print dyes were fitted, not digitised.

newson2017.short: Newson et al. 2017, the Boolean film grain model
newson2017.citation: Cited in raw-native docs/shaders/README.md as Newson et al. 2017 (realistic film grain rendering). Read status: secondary, through the README; primary not read this session.
claims: raw-native's grain follows the Boolean model the README attributes to Newson et al. 2017.
newson2017.does_not_prove: That the grain matches any measured stock.

rn-pr74.citation: HarperZ9/raw-native pull request #74, merged 2026-10-10; evidence/m2-retro3d-bounds.json and m2-retro3d-swiftshader.json.
claims: Vertex snap and affine UVs against a CPU twin on SwiftShader: 12 cases, 0 coverage mismatches away from edges, no texel more than one away; both controls fail. The first run failed the texel bound and the amendment is kept beside the bounds.
rn-pr74.does_not_prove: That the look matches any particular console, or performance.

rn-m3.citation: HarperZ9/raw-native pull request #79, merged 2026-10-10; evidence/m3-lighting-bounds.json and m3-lighting-runs.json; ROADMAP M3 status.
claims: Clustered light assignment against a brute-force list: 0 misses over 55,270 in-frustum points of 65,536 drawn. M3 criterion 7 passes on WARP, SwiftShader and the RTX 4090.
rn-m3.does_not_prove: Anything under does_not_prove in the bounds file; M3 criterion 1 (verified scenes with path-traced error) is still open.

rn-paint-parity.citation: HarperZ9/raw-native evidence/shaders-paint-parity-swiftshader.json (bounds fixed 2026-10-10 before the first run), main fdee283.
claims: 15 still, motion and post paint cases on SwiftShader: maximum difference 1 code in 255 in every case.
rn-paint-parity.does_not_prove: That the paint looks like any painter's work; the painted look rests on inferred technique (ADR 0016).

claims: 3 VHS cases: maximum difference 1 code in 255.
rn-vhs-parity.does_not_prove: Fidelity to any measured deck; the CPU tests check behaviours (bandwidth, chroma delay, head switch), not a real tape.

rn-pixel.citation: HarperZ9/raw-native docs/shaders/README.md, Pixel art section; method after Ebert, Texel Splatting: Perspective-Stable 3D Pixel Art, arXiv 2603.14587.
claims: Measured by reprojection on a small orbit, turn and dolly: 0.00% of compared pixels change colour with texel splatting, against 5.5%, 12.2% and 19.2% for naive pixelisation.
rn-pixel.n: three camera moves on one diorama
rn-pixel.does_not_prove: Stability at cell changes, where texels shift; or on meshes, since the scene is a raymarched SDF diorama.

claims: Every one of 16,777,216 sRGB colours gives the same palette index on GPU and CPU for two palette and mode pairs (pico8 with bayer8, ega with noise); 114 parity cases, 0 mismatched pixels.
rn-dither.quote: local run; not part of CI
rn-dither.does_not_prove: Results for other palette and mode pairs in the exhaustive test.

rn-pr73.citation: HarperZ9/raw-native pull request #73, merged 2026-10-10; evidence/m2-gltf-models.json (models and bounds written before the first run).
claims: Ten named glTF models import and render on the CPU reference, D3D12 and WebGPU: D3D12 WARP 10 of 10 verified, WebGPU on SwiftShader required 10 of 10 verified in CI.
rn-pr73.does_not_prove: Textures, materials beyond base colour, skinning or animation, or how the models look.

gltf_verified.from: PR #73 body: D3D12 WARP 10 of 10 verified; CI requires 10 of 10 on WebGPU SwiftShader
